new_milestone_release.description: A GenLayer-native milestone settlement layer beyond the accepted VerdictGraph baseline.
capabilities: constructor-bound acceptance authority and write-once accepted-project trust roots
immutable milestone terms inherited from the accepted baseline
hash-pinned HTTPS evidence with authority-registered origins and UTF-8 verification
independent GenLayer leader and validator review with PASS, FAIL, and UNDETERMINED outcomes
bounded challenge and re-review lifecycle with repairable fetch and hash failures
finality-only settlement messages to a deterministic exact-amount Vault
wallet-free public milestone Proof Pack with topology, source, hash, and EVM block verification

public_verification.frontend_release: The public application exposes milestone creation, authority registration, lifecycle controls, escrow state, hash-pinned submission, and the public Proof Pack route.
verification: Authority, Registry, and Adjudicator direct-mode suites passed.
Milestone Vault Foundry security and economic tests passed.
Frontend TypeScript check and production build passed.
Production dependency audit reported zero vulnerabilities.

interpretation: This artifact identifies the byte-pinned accepted baseline and the independently verifiable milestone release built beyond it. The on-chain Registry, GenLayer validator review, and deterministic Vault remain the authorities for lifecycle state, decision, and settlement; this document does not replace those finalized records.
